Ascaridia is an intestinal nematode infection, usually of birds, associated with diarrhea. Human Ascaris pulmonary migration should not be inferred.
Hereditary serpin deficiency or abnormal accumulation represents disordered protein metabolism; hepatic, pulmonary, neurologic and coagulation manifestations vary across the umbrella.
